remarks: MUST SEE!!! Come see this SPACIOUS, cedar-clad, massive Victorian double with intricate and ornate architectural detail and appeal, gorgeously set in the City of Buffalo’s desirable Elmwood Village neighborhood, steps from Colonial Circle and mere minutes to downtown. This beautiful home could easily be converted back into a single family home or kept as a cash-flowing investment property with charming period woodwork, decorative railings & trim, and hardwood floors throughout. Step into the lower unit family room with lofty ceilings and an abundance of NATURAL LIGHT opening to the generous eat-in kitchen with unique stained & leaded glass accents and plenty of room for customization. Enjoy sipping your morning coffee next to the woodburning fireplace with custom mantle & elegant tile surround while reminiscing of a bygone era. The lower unit currently has two bedrooms and a bathrm downstairs with a rear staircase leading to a third bedroom and second bathrm with clawfoot tub upstairs. The upper features two bedrms and one bath with an expansive layout including a dining room and living room with incredible turquoise tile fireplace surround w/bright white wood mantle to command higher rents. This property is conveniently located in a prime area close to schools, a plethora of local shops & entertainment. With updates including a newer high-efficiency Tempstat furnace, second rear furnace, HWT 2021 & more, this home has a private driveway for off-street parking and is a strong addition to your investment portfolio or perfect for owner occupied buyers collecting rental income to help cover a mortgage! See single family listing under B1705065 and showings start Wednesday, 8/12/26. Open House Saturday 10/3/2026 from 1:00-3:00 pm.
